control_domain.note: All semantic PART_PARAMS.scale controls; repeated runtime instances sharing part_id are one native control.

scope.source_audit: All 20 source files read; literal PART_PARAMS and runtime instance forest extracted. Cross-scale dependencies manually traced through geometry helpers; function reads below are conservative syntax, not proof of influence.
scope.claims_limit: No interpolated finite sample scheme is certified exact for arbitrary continuous values. Numerical additivity records reuse captured native geometry and skip any mesh with inconsistent count or polygon ordering.

sparse_interactions.formula: v(C,L) = L * F(C/L) for the joined leg mesh in its authored root coordinates; x/y centerline offsets and radii scale with L, z offsets and individual roots depend on C.
sparse_interactions.factorization: One ratio-conditioned native geometry family over q=C/L in [0.25,4], then multiply by L. This is source homogeneity, not a proof that linear interpolation of finite q samples is exact.
sparse_interactions.required_validation: Native joint C/L tests, including opposite extreme pairs (.4,1.6), (1.6,.4); stable tube frame and material/index correspondence.

cases.candidate_status: Source inference plus limited measured captures; not a general exactness certificate.
notes: carapace controls all eight joined walking-leg roots and both joined eye-stalk roots. walking_leg is one parameter, not eight independent native parameters.
eye_stalk and carapace contributions are additive translations plus uniform local shape. walking_leg is not additive because its tube frame depends on the carapace/leg scale ratio.

sparse_interactions.formula: bark_mat(phi,z,rng) conditionally consumes rng as scaled z crosses sine thresholds; the same rng subsequently decides grow child_count/twig_count.
sparse_interactions.factorization: Store exact native per-value branch geometry/topology at every supported UI hundredth .40...1.60 (121 states). Combine with independently generated trunk and reapply both native anchors.
sparse_interactions.required_validation: All 121 values with matching source/parameter hash, original native anchors and materials; arbitrary fractional values outside this set are unsupported unless generator logic is ported.

cases.candidate_status: Source inference plus limited measured captures; not a general exactness certificate.
notes: Branches are a separate native generator from the trunk. Trunk scaling changes its own geometry and the final branch attachment translation.

Branch material generation consumes the same PRNG used for recursion; scale-dependent material branches change actual branch topology. 121 exact branch states cover only 0.01-quantized UI values from 0.40 through 1.60, not arbitrary real-valued scales.

sparse_interactions.formula: P=pan scale,H=handle scale; R=max(3.05*P,1.365*H), x=1.30*H*(i/18-.5), y=R-sqrt(max(R*R-x*x,0)); bevel=.035*H.
sparse_interactions.factorization: Handle local geometry H*F(P/H), ratio range [.25,4]; native evaluated bevel output may reorder/split vertices. Grip local geometry remains independent; final placement includes pan and handle anchors.
sparse_interactions.required_validation: Opposite extremes and samples around clamp P/H=1.365/3.05=0.4475409836065574; validate evaluated topology/anchors.

cases.candidate_status: Source inference plus limited measured captures; not a general exactness certificate.
notes: Handle proximal curvature depends on the pan radius; the grip has independent local geometry and follows the handle distal anchor. Evaluated bevel topology/correspondence must be checked.

sparse_interactions.formula: head width=6.156*f*h, thickness=.34*f*h; remaining detail widths/heights add h-dependent terms.
foot width=5.928*f*d, thickness=.31*f*d; remaining details add d-dependent terms.
mattress w=4.68*f*m, l=7.54*f*m, h=.62*m. Downstream positions use these dimensions.
blanket w=4.5864*f*m*b, l=5.5796*f*m*b; blanket center y=-.754*f*m; comforter contact local y=-.22*l. Blanket normalized surface profile z depends only on b.
q=f*m; pillow x=+/-1.17*q, y=3.77*q-.58*p. u=abs(1-(1.16/7.54)*p/q); z=.62*m+.055*m*max(0,.75*(1-u*u))-.045*m*max(.5,u)^4. This updates actual mattress anchor patches and whole pillow placement.
sparse_interactions.factorization: Evaluate this explicit source formula for mattress pillow-zone patches and paired pillow placement; products alone do not capture the rational/max anchor-height term.

Both headboard and footboard width/thickness multiply frame.scale and own scale. Mattress width/depth multiply frame and mattress; blanket width/depth multiply frame, mattress and blanket.
Joined four-leg and two-pillow meshes must preserve independent component attachment positions.

sparse_interactions.formula: P=pole.scale,T=tray.scale,r=.04*P; outer=max(.32*T,.168*P); thick=max(.055*T,.026*P); collar_r=max(.085*T,.074*P); collar_h=max(.18*T,2.2*thick); lip_w=min(.11*outer,max(.026*T,.018*P)).
sparse_interactions.factorization: T*F(P/T), ratio [.25,4]. Threshold list is not exhaustive because lip min composes piecewise branches; use the complete formulas.

sparse_interactions.formula: P=pole.scale,S=shade.scale,r=.04*P,h=1.18*S; rb=max(.68*S,.32*P); rt=max(.45*S,.22*P); if rt>=rb:rt=.68*rb; wall=min(max(.028*S,.0088*P),.08*rb); ri=max(rb+(rt-rb)*v-wall+.35*ripple,.128*P); mount_r=max(.062*P,.074*S); mount_h=max(.19*S,.144*P); strut_z=.58*mount_h; r2=max(rb+(rt-rb)*(strut_z/h)-wall-.035*S,2*mount_r).
sparse_interactions.factorization: S*F(P/S), ratio [.25,4]. Native placement follows pole top; source-based formulas or validated ratio response need the strut division term and composed clamps.
